completed_null_results.interpretation: Three independent from-scratch policy seeds were completed for each of A1 and A6, and all 30 frozen schema-2 cells passed integrity audit. Neither arm passed the preregistered flat gates, so the original NO_PROMOTION remains unchanged and T/P, matched baselines, hardware, and RA-L conclusions remain blocked.

All 120 frozen schema-2 cells for paired A6/A8 policy seeds completed, but A8 did not satisfy the preregistered absolute, stability, safety, and paired-causal promotion contract. The immutable outcome is NO_PROMOTION.

completed_engineering_canaries.design: One A6 seed-20261102 gate-15k source was warm-started with only the physically validated reset curriculum changed, then audited at 0/1k/3k/final on five grounded reset modes.
completed_engineering_canaries.result: Gate 1k reached 100 percent strict success in all five modes, but joint-speed, mechanical-power, and root-motion tails remain unsuitable for hardware deployment; later gates did not improve success and worsened important safety tails.
